extension_notice: Affine/power/bounded/spline and prediction-only ridge are lightweight calibration extensions under method flexibility, not the literal one-global-scalar B roadmap. Strict median/huber/scalar controls remain.

losses.absrel: smooth absolute relative error with epsilon.001, normalized by fit-median reference
losses.rmse: equal-image RMSE normalized by fit-median reference
losses.balanced: sum of normalized smoothAbsRel, equal-imageRMSE, and softplus((abs(logerror)-log1.25)/.02)*.02

regularization: Only spline: .01 mean squared adjacent slope difference + .001 mean squared slope departure from1
selection_rule: Primary requires all three full-resolution OOF means better than median by1e-6. Prefer those whose one-sided scene-bootstrap Bonferroni lower bound is positive for all three, across18candidates*3metrics. Among confident candidates minimize AbsRel. If no confident candidates but joint-positive means exist, choose maximum minimum normalized gain as explicitly provisional. No qualifying mean candidate means do not test; expand training-only development.
ablation_rule: Before test freeze primary and one all-three-positive best-AbsRel candidate per extension family; no post-test refit or selection.
disclosure: Exploratory continuation after historical official test exposure; no test observations enter fitting/CV/selection. Conditional bootstrap does not refit models.
